description:
Shin Ui-jeong had been relieving the stress from work and home by partying wildly at gay clubs.

That day, too, Ui-jeong visited the club to blow off steam and met Kwon Cha-kyung, a man with exactly the kind of strong body and face he likes, but...

"You slut, do you like it?"

Ah, I picked a completely insane bastard...

What are the chances that your one-night turns out to be a gangster who just got out of prison? After realizing that Cha-kyung is a dangerous man, Ui-jeong tries to escape the situation by any means necessary, but it seems being a gangster bastard's kept lover suits him better than he expected...
